source: GWAS Catalog GCST90012074, Fenland cohort (Pietzner et al., Nat Commun 2021; PMID 33067605)
partial_rationale: File is a plain gzip sorted by chromosome and cannot be indexed (no BGZF FEXTRA). Only blocks covering chr1-chr16 were downloaded; tail chromosomes are not needed for the CX3CL1 region.
why_not_ukbppp: Synapse syn51364943 returns HTTP 403 GEO_RESTRICTION from this region (NIH NOT-OD-25-083); a PAT would not help. EBI FTP is not geo-restricted.
